title: Grateful Dead Live at Milwaukee Performing Arts Center on 1972-10-24

ai_review.summary: Fair‑quality soundboard capture of a high‑energy show with standout jams on The Other One, Playin', Truck and Philo Stomp.
ai_review.review: The recording is a soundboard source that suffers from low levels, some hiss and an occasional vocal cut, but remains listenable. Musically the concert is adventurous and lively, highlighted by a marathon 25‑minute "Playin'", fiery renditions of The Other One, Truck, Philo Stomp and a melting Space jam. Overall fans praise the performance despite the modest technical fidelity.

ai_rating.rationale: Four detailed reviews give an average of 4 stars; reviewers note strong musical moments and only moderate recording flaws, leading to a rating just above the mean.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Low overall levels, some hiss and distant sound, occasional vocal cut (Spanish Lady), tape‑flip artifacts; mix is acceptable but not crisp.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A loose but adventurous set with long improvisational passages; the second half builds into extended jams that maintain momentum.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Sharp leads, shredding guitar on The Other One and other jams; "JBG - the shredder" noted.
